fieldValues.title: How this handbook is made
fieldValues.body:
The handbook is an SRS repository in `handbook/`, with its own package `com.semanticops.handbook`: a `chapter` (title, body), a `stage` (theory, status, practice, gaps, open questions, test) and an `element` (kind, home, meaning, read by). The root container's outline is the order of the document. The composition `handbook` renders it. ```mermaid flowchart LR R["handbook/ records
(source of truth)"] -->|"srs render composition"| M["docs/handbook.md
(projection)"] W["Weekly handbook watcher"] -->|"srs record update,
container members add/move"| R M -->|"render-handbook.mjs --check
fails on drift"| CI[CI] ``` - **Edit the records, never the markdown.** Use the srs CLI: `srs record update`, `srs container members add|move|remove`, then `node scripts/render-handbook.mjs` and commit both. - **Check:** `node scripts/render-handbook.mjs --check` exits 1 if `docs/handbook.md` differs from the records. - **Why it is built this way:** it answers SP-67 (the handbook says things that are no longer true) and SP-68 (no one place tells how work is driven), both suggested in the Programme coordination domain, and SP-65 (the same rule restated in many places drifts apart). - **Keep it current:** the weekly handbook watcher (`routines/handbook-watcher.md`) does this as a routine. Anyone may do it in a session.
